summary: Backend+frontend regression executed against public URL with real APIs/cookies. Backend pytest: 16 passed, 3 failed. Core public pages load and major internal pages render, but browser-origin write actions are blocked by 403 Origin middleware mismatch, local admin login from /login fails in browser, and year toggle 2027->2026 can crash StockDashboard runtime.

critical.issue: Origin middleware rejects valid public site origin with 403 'Asal permintaan tidak diizinkan'. Browser login/logout/user updates fail while direct API calls from test client can pass.
Throttle behavior not reached as specified: repeated invalid username attempts stayed 401 and did not produce 429 in browser-based/public route flow.
Plan data overlaps both years for same items (example item-001 has >0 in 2026 and 2027), violating requested exclusive-year planning rule.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime crash after toggling 2027 back to 2026: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading IN)' from weekly_activity access during stale 2027 data render.

Logout POST returns 403 Origin rejection; session remains active and /app/stok remains accessible.

issues: No horizontal overflow detected on tested breakpoints.

action_items: Fix backend allowed-origin matching so actual public origin (preview.emergentagent.com URL from frontend/.env) is accepted for POST/PATCH/DELETE.
Re-test admin browser login/logout and user PATCH after Origin fix; these are currently blocked end-to-end.
Fix StockDashboard state safety when switching 2027->2026 (guard weekly_activity/status_counts until 2026 payload is loaded).
Implement/verify 5 failed attempts then 429 throttle for invalid username route under real public traffic path.
Align planning data with exclusive year rule if this requirement is mandatory (no dual non-zero across 2026/2027 per item).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py origin check uses strict CORS_ORIGINS list in custom middleware while app also has allow_origin_regex; mismatch causes legitimate browser origin to be rejected before route handlers.
StockDashboard uses 2026-only fields (weekly_activity) without defensive fallback during async year toggle transitions, causing runtime crash with 2027 payload shape.
Brute-force lockout logic appears ineffective in public-route behavior; verify identifier stability and threshold increment path under proxy/CDN client IPs.

success_rate.frontend: ~65% of requested flows validated (remaining blocked by CRITICAL origin issue)

seed_data_creation: No business catalog reseed/deletion. UI verification used existing seeded admin session token test_session_admin_001 only for read/navigation checks after login flow was blocked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Major blocker: browser write actions return 403 due origin mismatch (login/logout/user patch). After fixing this, rerun full UI e2e from /login with admin/admin, then retest confirm dialog persistence and logout redirect. Also retest year toggle crash path 2027->2026 and throttle 429 behavior.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 Origin failures: Reproduced in browser and backend logs: POST /api/auth/admin/login, PATCH /api/users/{id}, POST /api/auth/logout return 403 while GET endpoints work. Custom middleware checks Origin against CORS_ORIGINS exact list and rejects current public origin, even though CORSMiddleware has broader regex. Mitigation: unify/normalize origin allowlist logic (or reuse CORSMiddleware decision path) so public domain from frontend/.env is explicitly accepted. RCA-2 Year toggle crash: Repro by opening /app/stok, click Tahun 2027 then Tahun 2026. During async transition, component renders with 2027-shaped data while 2026 UI computes weekly_activity.IN, causing TypeError. Mitigation: null-safe guards or per-year data shape normalization before render. RCA-3 Throttle: repeated invalid username attempts did not emit 429 under tested path; likely identifier/count behavior under proxied request source differs from expectation; verify login_attempts increments and lock condition with stable identifier in production-like ingress.
